derivation: One internal reflection gives deviation D=pi+2i-4r and backscatter angle alpha=4r-2i, with sin(i)=n sin(r). Its stationary maximum has cos²(i)=(n²-1)/3. For n=4/3, alpha is about 42.03°. Neighboring incidence angles yield similar exit directions. Rotational symmetry around the antisolar viewing axis produces a circle of equal angular radius.
limitations: Geometric ray model omits Fresnel intensity, diffraction, interference and detailed dispersion. Drawn sky-circle radii represent angular positions schematically.
